map.TDS 评级：按阈值分段判定水质: TDS rating: threshold bands for dissolved solids
map.📚 深度解析：水质TDS值评估（输入数值）: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Water Quality TDS Assessment (Value Input)
map.自来水/井水入户前快速评估。: Quick assessment of tap water/well water before entering the home.
map.净水器出水合格性核对。: Check the compliance of water purifier outlet water.
map.养殖/灌溉水质适用性。: Suitability of water quality for aquaculture/irrigation.
map.TDS 350 mg/L（达标）、pH 7.2（达标）、浊度 3 NTU（偏高）: TDS 350 mg/L (compliant), pH 7.2 (compliant), turbidity 3 NTU (slightly high), residual chlorine 0 (not disinfected): can be used for general household purposes, and before drinking it is advisable to filter + disinfect (boiling/UV). Tip: microorganisms and heavy metals must also be tested; the indicators are only at the physical and chemical level.
map.TDS 反映溶解固体总量，过低口感平淡、过高有异味；饮用水 300–600 mg: TDS reflects the total dissolved solids; too low tastes flat and too high tastes off. Drinking water of 300-600 mg/L is common; the key is that harmful substances meet the standard.
map.浊度高有什么风险？: What is the risk of high turbidity?
map.浊度高的水易携病原微生物且影响消毒效果，饮用水浊度须低并有微生物检测。: Water with high turbidity easily carries pathogenic microorganisms and impairs disinfection; drinking water must have low turbidity and undergo microbial testing.
map.TDS(总溶解固体)反映水中溶解性无机物总量，GB 5749限值≤500mg/L: TDS (total dissolved solids) reflects the total amount of dissolved inorganics in water; the GB 5749 limit is ≤500mg/L
map.TDS与电导率正相关，电导率≈TDS/0.55(μS/cm): TDS is positively correlated with conductivity: conductivity ≈ TDS/0.55 (μS/cm)
map.TDS过低(<30mg/L)几乎不含矿物质，长期饮用需补充: TDS too low (<30mg/L) contains almost no minerals and needs supplementation for long-term drinking
map.TDS不能反映细菌、重金属等有害物质，需配合其他指标: TDS cannot reflect harmful substances such as bacteria and heavy metals and needs to be combined with other indicators
map.水温影响TDS测量值，建议在25°C标准温度下测量: Water temperature affects the TDS measurement; it is recommended to measure at the standard temperature of 25°C
map.关于「水质TDS值评估（输入数值）」: About the "Water Quality TDS Assessment (Value Input)"
map.水质TDS值评估工具，输入总溶解固体(TDS)数值，对照GB 5749饮用水标准: Water quality TDS assessment tool: enter the total dissolved solids (TDS) value and it automatically determines the water quality grade and suitable uses against the GB 5749 drinking water standard.
map.估算电导率 EC(µS/cm) = TDS(mg/L) ÷ 0.55；TDS 分: Estimate conductivity EC (µS/cm) = TDS (mg/L) ÷ 0.55; TDS grades: ≤50 ultrapure water, ≤100 high-quality purified water, ≤300 good drinking water, ≤500 qualified drinking water (GB 5749-2022 limit), ≤1000 elevated, not recommended for direct drinking, >1000 high-salinity water, not drinkable. Validation: no strict checks; water temperature defaults to 20°C. Criteria: use-based overlay — drinking use with TDS >500 is rated "non-compliant (above the drinking-water standard)"; purified-water use with TDS >50 suggests RO reverse-osmosis treatment.
map.限值参考：GB 5749-2022 溶解性总固体 ≤1000 mg/L；TDS: Reference limit: GB 5749-2022 total dissolved solids ≤1000 mg/L; TDS does not reflect microbial or heavy-metal safety.
map.用途标注为饮用：TDS 只作口感/工艺参考，不能判定安全、达标或可直饮；请以完整: Use marked as drinking: TDS is only a sensory/process reference and cannot determine safety, compliance or direct-drink suitability; rely on complete water testing and local supply/regulatory conclusions.
map.纯水口感目标常设为 ≤50 mg/L；TDS 低不代表无菌，制备与储存仍需保证卫: A purified-water sensory target is often ≤50 mg/L; low TDS does not mean sterile, and preparation and storage must remain hygienic.
map.TDS 分层：0-50 极低 | 50-100 低 | 100-300 中等 |: TDS bands: 0-50 very low | 50-100 low | 100-300 moderate | 300-500 higher | 500-1000 high | >1000 above limit (sensory/dissolved-solids reference only)
map.TDS(总溶解固体)反映水中溶解性无机物总量，GB 5749-2022 溶解性总: TDS reflects total dissolved inorganic matter; the GB 5749-2022 total dissolved solids limit is 1000 mg/L
map.水质TDS值评估工具，输入总溶解固体(TDS)数值，给出溶解性固体分层与感官参考: Water TDS tool: enter TDS for dissolved-solids bands and sensory reference; TDS cannot determine drinking-water safety, which requires complete testing.
map.家用净水器出水 TDS 变化趋势观察（同时结合厂家说明与检测）。: Observe TDS trends in household purifier output, together with manufacturer guidance and testing.
map.冲茶/咖啡用水的口感粗筛。: Rough sensory screening for tea/coffee water.
map.养殖/灌溉用水的溶解性固体大致分层，仍需专项水质检测。: Rough dissolved-solids bands for aquaculture/irrigation water; dedicated water testing is still required.
map.TDS 350 mg/L、25℃ → 估算电导率 636 μS/cm，属 300: TDS 350 mg/L at 25°C → estimated conductivity 636 µS/cm, in the 300–500 higher-TDS band (sensory reference); TDS cannot determine direct-drink suitability—test microbes, heavy metals and disinfectants.
map.TDS 只反映溶解性固体总量；低 TDS 口感偏淡但不代表无菌或安全，高 TDS: TDS only reflects total dissolved solids; low TDS may taste flat but does not mean sterile or safe, while high TDS may taste heavy. Safety requires complete microbe, heavy-metal and disinfectant testing.
map.TDS 能判断水能不能喝吗？: Can TDS tell whether water is drinkable?
map.不能。TDS 不反映病原体、重金属等污染物；是否适合饮用须依据完整水质检测与当地: No. TDS does not reflect pathogens or heavy metals; drinking suitability requires complete water testing and local supply/regulatory conclusions, not TDS alone.
map.输入 TDS 与水温，给出溶解性固体分层和感官参考；TDS 不能判定微生物、重金: Enter TDS and water temperature to show dissolved-solids bands and sensory reference; TDS cannot determine microbial, heavy-metal or disinfectant safety. Drinking-water safety requires complete testing.
map.TDS(总溶解固体)反映水中溶解性无机物总量；GB 5749-2022 溶解性总: TDS reflects total dissolved inorganic matter; the GB 5749-2022 total dissolved solids limit is 1000 mg/L
map.TDS 低不代表无菌或安全，饮用水安全须看微生物、重金属等完整检测: Low TDS does not mean sterile or safe; drinking-water safety requires complete microbe and heavy-metal testing.
map.分层与感官参考；仅用于口感与工艺参考，不能作为饮用水安全、达标或可直饮的依据: TDS bands and sensory reference for taste and process only; this is not a basis for drinking-water safety, compliance or direct-drink suitability.
map.估算电导率 EC(µS/cm) = TDS(mg/L) ÷ 0.55；TDS 数: Estimated conductivity EC (µS/cm) = TDS (mg/L) ÷ 0.55; TDS bands (taste/dissolved-solids reference): ≤50 very low, ≤100 low, ≤300 moderate, ≤500 higher, ≤1000 high (GB 5749-2022 total dissolved solids limit 1000 mg/L), >1000 above limit. TDS reflects total dissolved inorganic matter only and cannot determine microbial, heavy-metal or disinfectant safety; drinking-water safety requires complete testing. Purpose notes are taste/process references only, not compliance or direct-drink conclusions.
map.的溶解性固体大致分层，仍需专项水质检测。: rough dissolved-solids bands only; dedicated water testing is still required.
map.溶解性固体高，接近或达到 GB 5749 溶解性总固体限值: High dissolved solids, near or at the GB 5749 total dissolved solids limit
map.超过 GB 5749-2022 溶解性总固体限值（1000 mg/L）: Exceeds the GB 5749-2022 total dissolved solids limit (1000 mg/L)
